This master services agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of 06/03/2026 (the "Effective Date") by and
between Thamesview Logistics Ltd, with its registered office at 14 King Street, Bristol ("Party A"), and Westbrook
Pharma Ltd, with its registered office at 14 King Street, Bristol ("Party B").

1. Term

This Agreement shall remain in force for a period of 36 months from the Effective Date unless terminated earlier in
accordance with Section 7.

2. Confidentiality

Each party shall keep confidential all non-public information received from the other party and shall use it solely for the
purposes of this Agreement.

3. Governing Law

This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of England and Wales.

Signatures

Party A    Thamesview Logistics Ltd / Oliver Bennett
Party B    Westbrook Pharma Ltd / Harry Whitfield
